content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DBEO Prayagraj Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.Prayagraj.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Basic Education Officer Prayagraj (DBEO Prayagraj) for various teaching and non-teaching positions in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 36 vacancies available for various teaching and non-teaching posts including teachers, cooks, chowkidars, and PGT faculty roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for DBEO Prayagraj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it by post to the designated official address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the completed offline application form is 13-10-2026. Make sure your application reaches well in time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts under this notification is a minimum of 25 years and a maximum of 45 years as per the guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any category including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Full Time Teachers?
faq.answer: Full Time Teachers in Science, Math, and English require a relevant graduation degree along with the Upper Primary TET qualification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for PGT Principal?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the PGT Principal (Female) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises the preparation of a merit list, followed by an interview and subsequent document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form from the official website www.Prayagraj.nic.in or via the direct links provided in this article.
